notes: All nine pre/Sinkhorn/project cases and the full-FP32 projection case have frozen inputs and CPU goldens.
Stored data/out tensors are CPU goldens; logs record comparisons with actual device outputs.
Projection probes require exact positive/negative midpoint results for both HF32 operands.
Sinkhorn probes include cancellation that distinguishes sequential from pairwise split-K summation.
The existing full-FP32 branch defines only the active coefficient columns; unused scratch padding is not compared.
SWA and layer runs did not request save_data; their deterministic specs remain in the model sources.
Original model goldens and thresholds are retained; extraction of the CPU coefficient helper was checked for exact equivalence.
No PyPTO or CANNBotDSL framework changes. The output-projection archive has the existing companion patches.
Native ELF files and installed toolchains are excluded; runtime device text images are included.
